text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you there! Come get yourself a

good-morning cuddle!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. That should cheer ya up! Oh,
looks like
somebody else needs a good
mood-boostin'
too...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I've been out here squeezing some
energy into
anybody lookin' too down in
the dumps!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to my day off yesterday, my
energy
reserves are overflowing!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like Taiki Shuttle got in some
good rest.
